body_lead: CHENNAI: Deputy Chief Minister Udayanidhi Stalin on Monday launched two digital platforms aimed at aligning private capital with government priorities and strengthening data-driven governance in Tamil Nadu. Udayanidhi, who is also the ex-officio vice-chairman of the state planning commission, unveiled the Tamil Nadu Corporate Social Responsibility (TNCSR) web portal-branded Mission Inaippagam and the TiNAI-Tamil Nadu Land Use Information System (TNLUIS) at the secretariat. The CSR portal has been developed with support from the United Nations Development Programme.
